title: ERP order activities (queue 'erp')
description: erp.create-order-with-reservation takes quote-accepted.v1.json and returns ErpOrderResult. erp.cancel-order takes CancelOrderRequest and returns CancelOrderResult. Non-retryable failure types: ValidationFailed, InsufficientStock.

created.description: false when the order already existed for this (tenant, quote).

cancelled.description: false when it was already cancelled.
